# Tender Response -- Dnro 58/02.08.01/2026

Visakoivu Oy is pleased to submit this response to Vuorikylan kunta's invitation to tender for the electrical and HVAC maintenance framework agreement. Visakoivu confirms it meets the eligibility requirements set out in Section 3 of the invitation.

Proposed service levels are structured by fault priority: emergency faults receive a 4-hour response, urgent faults a 24-hour response, and routine work is completed within 5 working days.

During the works, environmental management arrangements include noise and dust control near occupied buildings, careful scheduling around school hours, and controlled handling of any regulated materials encountered.

Quality control follows a staged inspection process: pre-work assessment, in-progress checks against the work order, and a final function test before sign-off, with records retained and available to the contracting authority on request.

The proposed HVAC maintenance agreement covers scheduled inspection, filter and component replacement, and seasonal performance checks across the properties covered by the framework.

Limitation of liability is proposed on a per-claim basis, capped at the contract value, in line with Visakoivu's professional indemnity cover.

A price indexation clause is proposed, linked annually to the relevant published cost index and applied at each contract anniversary.

Visakoivu does not currently anticipate using subcontractors for this contract; should this change, the Subcontractor List will be submitted before any subcontracted work begins.

The tender is submitted as a single PDF file, without password protection, with price quoted in EUR/m2/year as required.

Waste arising from the works is sorted on site in line with the municipality's collection categories.
